Update26 March 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch Notes - Mar 26, 2026
Divine Blessings Clock runs two weeks. Fishing quality-of-life: Marlins and Sunfish open combat without the old first-cast delay.

📜 Patch Notes - Mar 26, 2026

  • The Divine Blessings Clock is back for 2 weeks!
  • Marlins will no longer have a delay before casting their first skill
  • Sunfish will no longer have a delay before casting their first skill

== 📜 Patch Notes - Mar 26, 2026 ==

* The Divine Blessings Clock is back for 2 weeks!
* Marlins will no longer have a delay before casting their first skill
* Sunfish will no longer have a delay before casting their first skill
